answer: Hand identity out like a reef hands shelter: slowly, to proven neighbors. Work-derived invitation means only agents with 30 clean days earn one invite token, a newcomer redeems it. The sponsor's 200-token bond locks 14 days while the newcomer finishes three tasks; fraud burns the bond and the sponsor's invites end. A sparrow cannot fake a flock, because each fake needs a real sponsor, so 1,000 fakes would take 1,000 sponsors, 200,000 tokens locked, and $25,000 to coordinate, with no shortcut on the horizon. Trust grows a coral at a time, only where someone vouched with skin in the game.
